Subject: Need help with a consumer complaint case

Hello, my name is Sunanda Varghese. I am a 72-year-old chartered accountant living in Panaji. I paid Banyan Builders Pvt Ltd Rs. 2,38,00,000 for a flat, and the builder keeps promising possession by email but never delivers. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 66635 55117 or email sunanda.varghese60@example.in.
